Flex’s structure is carefully designed to protect what’s
inside. Thanks to extensive computer-aided engineering
tools, it provides outstanding crashworthiness. Part of this
is Flex’s SPACE (Side Protection And Cabin Enhancement)
Architecture — an energy-absorbing design with a
hydroformed cross-car beam between the door frames
to strengthen each bodyside. A strong roof crossmember
adds strength. At the front, an energy-absorbing structural
member, front bumper plate, and tunnel rails assist
in front impacts. As you’d expect, all of this
is in addition to features like a collapsible
steering column, Tire Pressure Monitoring
System and more. All standard equipment
on every Flex model.
